sourceEvidence.title: Director of Manufacturing
sourceEvidence.quote:
- Plan and coordinate resources and workflow to efficiently build devices in support of corporate and project goals. Provide status updates to the cross-functional teams. 
- Track and report production metrics (yield, throughput, labor times) to assess manufacturing performance. Create and present manufacturing updates for management review. 
- Recruit, train, and manage the Manufacturing team, consisting of assemblers, supervisors, a manager, technicians, and line support engineers. 
- Manage responsibilities within the Manufacturing Department: line layout and workflow; critical spare equipment and equipment maintenance; kanban for supplies and components; CER monitoring; and lot history record reconciliation and closure.
